# KI: Open Knowledge Framework (OKF v0.2)

## Operational Summary
OKF v0.2 establishes a Git-native agent memory specification using plain-text Markdown files with YAML frontmatter. It replaces heavy vector databases and recurring embedding API calls with in-memory BM25 lexical ranking and pre-edit governance scoping (`SearchForPath`). Autonomous agents check target file paths against concept `code_refs` prior to proposing edits, preventing architectural regressions and enforcing invariants. Mutations automatically maintain parent `index.md` tables and immutable `log.md` audit ledgers while strictly prohibiting AI self-attestation as human verified.
